entry.name: lessthan
entry.digest: Compare numbers for less than condition
entry.description: Compares two values to see if one value is less than a second. Outputs a 1 if the number is less than the comparison-number or 0 if it is equal to or greater than it.

arguments.name: initial-comparison-value
arguments.description: Sets the initial value, to be compared with a number received in the left inlet. A float argument forces a float comparison.
